question: After the branch is rebased cleanly, should ClickClack adopt a focusable horizontal-scroll wrapper as the standard rendering and accessibility behavior for Markdown tables?
rationale: The patch is a new user-visible Markdown rendering convention rather than a repair to an established documented contract, so final UX and accessibility acceptance belongs with the repository's frontend direction.

options.title: Accept the wrapper pattern
options.body: Approve the native-table wrapper approach once the contributor rebases, regenerates assets, and reruns the focused real-app test.

options.title: Request a narrower presentation change
options.body: Keep overflow containment but adjust the wrapper semantics or table styling before accepting it as the shared Markdown-table convention.

recommendation.title: Accept the wrapper pattern
recommendation.body: Approve the native-table wrapper approach once the contributor rebases, regenerates assets, and reruns the focused real-app test.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the most direct available implementation context and can prepare the rebased validation for a frontend reviewer.
